t: Bunn-O-Matic Corporation - Wikipedia
s: December 22, 2025 - Bunn-O-Matic Corporation is an American manufacturer of dispensed beverage equipment (including coffee and tea) headquartered in Springfield, Illinois, with a plant in Creston, Iowa. Currently, the corporation's products are sold under the BUNN and Bunn-O-Matic brands.
